answer: The protocol’s Sybil resistance is anchored in an atlas of collateralized capital lockups, where each Sybil node requires a stake commensurate with its contribution to the consensus mechanism. Quadratic slashing penalties escalate attack costs super-linearly, ensuring that the marginal cost of a Sybil cluster reaches a summit surpassing any possible value extraction. This dynamic, combined with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, elevates the nadir of attack profitability below zero, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where no attacker can achieve positive expected utility.
